title: Four journey cards and a map of Makkah and Madinah
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Summer 1: The mission in Makkah and the Hijrah
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y2 lesson 9 (Pupil PDF worksheet: four journey cards and a map of Makkah and Madinah)
intro: Lesson 9: The Hijrah: Allah is with us. To understand why the Prophet ﷺ and Abu Bakr made the Hijrah to Madinah and how they trusted Allah

cards:
Hijrah (هِجْرَة)
the journey from Makkah to
Madinah

Madinah (المَدِينَة)
the city that welcomed the
Muslims

Abu Bakr (أَبُو بَكْر)
the Prophet's ﷺ best friend
and companion

companion
a friend who goes with you
blocks.task: use them to test yourself or a partner.

questions.q: What did the Prophet ﷺ say to Abu Bakr in the cave?
questions.a: Do not be sad, Allah is with us
questions.model: Teacher: 'Abu Bakr was worried for the Prophet ﷺ. The Prophet ﷺ said: do not be sad, Allah is with us (9:40).'

questions.q: Put the four journey cards in order on the pupil PDF (leave Makkah, the cave, the desert, Madinah) and tell the story to your partner.
questions.model: Teacher places card 1: 'They left Makkah at night.'

questions.q: when could you remember 'Allah is with us'?
questions.a: When scared of the dark, before a test, when lost

questions.q: The Hijrah was the journey to ...
Back to our ponder: what helped the Prophet ﷺ and Abu Bakr feel safe?
